text:
ana: Quick check — PR #20522 ready for merge but linux-e2e flaky (see last CI). Planning Tue 07:00 UTC merge window. If CI doesn't go green I'll reschedule to Wed canary. Need reviews/approvals or a slot swap. Anyone available for quick review? cc @mike @jen :wave:

mike: Can you paste the failing job logs? is it unit or e2e?

ana: It's linux-matrix e2e, failing on auth-integration occasionally. Logs: ```FAIL tests/auth_integration_test.py::TestAuth::test_token_rotation AssertionError: expected 200 != 500``` Repro locally with `pytest tests/auth_integration_test.py::TestAuth::test_token_rotation -q`

sam: I saw a similar flake yesterday. Looks like a timing issue with the mock KMS in CI env.

ci-bot: CI status for PR #20522 — linux-matrix: failed, mac-matrix: passed, docker-integration: passed. Reruns available: true.

jen: We're entering a deploy freeze Wed 12:00 UTC — if you want Wed canary, you need to land before that or reserve a canary slot. I can free up a slot Wed 08:30 UTC if you rebase.

ana: Thanks @jen — can you reserve Wed 08:30? I'll try a rebase now.

lucas: I can rerun the linux job and attach debug flags. Want me to trigger?

ana: Yes please, `ci-bot rerun job linux-matrix --debug` would help. Also I'll push a small timing tweak to the test.

mike: I'll review the PR now, give ETA ~45m.

ci-bot: Rerun triggered by lucas for linux-matrix (PR #20522). Debug logs enabled.

sam: FYI the workaround that helped before was increasing the sleep in test from 0.1 -> 0.3s. Not ideal but unblocks landing.

ana: Pushed test tweak + rebased onto main at 1739997700. PTAL @mike

mike: Reviewed, left one minor comment on a log message. Approving after that.

jen: Canary slot reserved Wed 08:30 UTC. I'll post reminder in #eng-releases an hour before.

mike: Comment addressed, approved. :thumbsup:

ci-bot: linux-matrix now passed for PR #20522.

ana: Great — merging to canary per plan. Will monitor. Thanks everyone :pray:

deploy-bot: Noted: PR #20522 merged to staging at 1739997899. Canary deploy scheduled Wed 08:30 UTC.

lucas: I'll watch metrics during canary.
